title: [YouPass Collect] - Cellular company contract costs in 2012
prompt: The line graph shows the average cost of monthly contract of four different cellular companies in one European country from January to September in 2012, measured in euros. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The line graph illustrates the average monthly costs of mobile contracts for four telecommunications providers in a European nation over a nine-month period in 2012.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: Overall, three of the four companies experienced upward trends in their contract prices, with the exception of Sim TX, which fluctuated and declined marginally. Additionally, Alpha demonstrated the most dramatic growth, surging from the lowest to the highest cost by the end of the period.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: Regarding the two initially more expensive providers, Domo's monthly contract cost stood at €15 in January, slightly higher than Lex's €12. Over the following months, Domo's prices rose steadily, reaching a peak of €25 in July before declining slightly to €22.5 by September. Similarly, Lex's costs also increased throughout most of the period, rising to €19 in the final month, despite a minor dip to €10 in February.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: As for the remaining companies, Alpha began at just €5 in January, the lowest among all providers, while Sim TX started at €8.5. Alpha's costs underwent a remarkable transformation, fluctuating initially between €4.5 and €12.5 before surging dramatically to €25 by September, thereby quintupling in value and overtaking all other companies. In contrast, Sim TX's figures demonstrated an inconsistent pattern, peaking at €14.5 in June before declining sharply to €7.5 in the final month, making it the only provider to record an overall decrease.
